Container.Name: Camofox-Browser
Container.Overview: Private Camofox Browser REST backend for local AI agents and MCP adapters. It provides token-efficient Firefox-based browser automation and optional password-protected noVNC access for shared human-and-LLM browsing. This template pins the official multi-architecture 1.14.0 image, persists profiles locally, requires bearer authentication, and disables upstream crash telemetry.
Container.Requires: Set separate random Access and Cookie API keys before the first start. Keep ports 9377 and 6080 restricted to your LAN or VPN. noVNC is optional and disabled by default. The MCP adapter runs on each client and connects through CAMOFOX_BASE_URL.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent browser profiles, cookies, uploads, and short-lived traces. This directory can contain login credentials and must be backed up and protected.

Config.Name: REST API Port
Config.Description: Authenticated Camofox REST API. Restrict access to LAN or VPN.

Config.Name: noVNC Web Port
Config.Description: Optional noVNC browser desktop. Keep restricted to LAN/VPN; noVNC traffic is not encrypted by default.

Config.Name: Enable noVNC
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable shared human-and-LLM browser access through the noVNC web interface.

Config.Name: noVNC Password
Config.Description: Password for interactive noVNC access. Set 8 random ASCII characters before enabling noVNC; classic VNC authentication ignores additional characters.

Config.Name: noVNC Resolution
Config.Description: Virtual display resolution used by the interactive browser desktop.

Config.Name: noVNC Bind Address
Config.Description: Required inside Docker so the mapped noVNC port is reachable. Keep the host port restricted to LAN/VPN.

Config.Name: View Only
Config.Description: Set to 1 to prevent human mouse and keyboard input; keep 0 for interactive login and shared browsing.

Config.Name: Access Key
Config.Description: Required bearer token protecting normal REST and MCP operations.

Config.Name: Cookie API Key
Config.Description: Required bearer token for cookie import. Use a separate long random value.

Config.Name: Bind Address
Config.Description: Required inside the container so the mapped REST port is reachable.

Config.Name: Service Port
Config.Description: Internal HTTP port; keep aligned with the container port mapping.

Config.Name: Profile Directory
Config.Description: Persistent per-user cookies and localStorage.

Config.Name: Cookie Directory
Config.Description: Sandboxed location for optional Netscape-format cookie imports.

Config.Name: Upload Directory
Config.Description: Sandboxed location from which agents may upload files to websites.

Config.Name: Trace Directory
Config.Description: Short-lived Playwright trace archives when tracing is explicitly enabled.

Config.Name: Disable Crash Telemetry
Config.Description: Keep crash and hang reports local for this private deployment.

Config.Name: Maximum Sessions
Config.Description: Limit simultaneous isolated browser sessions for a small private deployment.

Config.Name: Maximum Tabs per Session
Config.Description: Limit tabs in each browser session.

Config.Name: Maximum Global Tabs
Config.Description: Hard global tab limit for the service.

Config.Name: Browser Idle Shutdown
Config.Description: Stop the browser engine after five idle minutes while keeping the REST service available.
